relationships.kind: the discipline that would let her bank and the one her body forbids
relationships.note: Hardening bone marrow stops the turnover her qi depends on, so the longest-lived body in the record is built out of the one material it may never stop replacing, and the form ladder's floor is the rung her longevity forbids. It is the exact counterpart of everything she can do: the organ she stores in is the organ she is not permitted to stop replacing. Three techniques of this kind have been offered to her as honours by a house that gives load and not edge, and she has refused all three, and has never let the refusals be recorded as modesty, because a modesty can be argued with and this cannot.

relationships.kind: the primer that teaches qi the short route and cannot be hurried
relationships.note: It teaches qi to take the short route through the long bones, and it grants steadier control and better affinity to outside energy and nothing at all that helps a strike land — which is a fair description of her whole practice and was written for a body that will take forty years to fill. She has been running it since before the house existed and has run it, on her estimate, about eleven times, and the reason it suits a deficit discipline is that it is the one technique that draws from the tissue rather than from the store, so it is the only thing in her whole practice that a thin reserve does not make impossible.

relationships.kind: the ground that makes her lifespan the shortest anybody's
relationships.note: Each tier runs faster than the one below by up to a hundredfold, so four centuries measured against a mortal's is a different quantity on every ground this body stands on. She came to the Scar for the approach and stayed, and the cost of staying is arithmetic rather than hardship: on the one tier whose clock runs five to fifty times slower, two hundred and seventy years is very nearly nothing, and she is the youngest member of her house by a wide margin. She has complained about it once, in writing, and withdrawn the complaint, which is the whole of her public record on the subject.

relationships.kind: the unbounded office that hands out load, and the one thing her technique requires her to refuse
relationships.note: Every sworn member who holds no office is a Ward, and the office recognises no stat at all, because what the house gives is load and load is not a stat. It is the most generous arrangement her species has ever built and it is built on the fact that a marrow store renews rather than empties, so a member can be given anything and will hold it. She has declined every grant for two hundred years and the house has had to invent a column for the refusals, which is the only way a Ward who declines forever can remain in an office whose whole content is accepting.

relationships.kind: a stop her species does not have
relationships.note: The densest bodies in the setting stop one gate short of the end of their own tier, and the era that produced the stop is the one era with no spare seat to stand outside on, so the composition reading and the practice reading predict the same thing from inside a complete composition and nothing observed can separate them. Her species has no such stop: no gate has ever refused a longmarrow and no ceiling was ever written for one. That makes her the only population in the setting that could confirm the seventeen from the far side, and the slowest at starting, and it makes the account held by the mortuary college that will not corroborate it — because corroboration needs a second body — the most interesting document she could ever be given, and she has never asked for it.

relationships.kind: the finding that a ceiling can be a limit nobody was issued
relationships.note: Realm nine had been read as a wall that cultivators failed to climb until the verdict established that it is a limit they were never issued, because the mortal tier seats a life law and that seat is already spent keeping plants and beasts coherent. The tier did not defeat anybody; it declined to seat them. Her own ceiling is not this one and she has never claimed it is: she has no ceiling, no refusal and no unissued limit, and she stops where her own arithmetic stops, which is the one kind of stop in the setting that is entirely self-imposed and therefore entirely hers to be wrong about.

reference_stats.summary: The most reliable reservoir in the record, run deliberately near empty, on a body that cannot fight and does not need to. She cannot be exhausted and cannot be hurried, and the only thing standing between her and the thirtieth gate is a subtraction she has maintained for two hundred years by refusing every gift she has been offered.

reference_stats.combat_read: Do not model her as a brawler in any form, including a patient one. She has no edge, no burst, no poise and no way to impose a fight; her entire combat value is that she is very difficult to remove. Every reading taken against her should end the same way: she is hit, she is not stopped, and she is still there, and the correct response to that is disengagement rather than a second strike. Do not offer her load. It is the house's product and the one thing her technique requires her to refuse, and a scene that hands her a full store has handed her a gate she cannot fund on her own arithmetic, which is the only thing in this setting capable of making her do something she has not done in two hundred years. The one lever that works is time: she cannot be hurried, cannot be exhausted and cannot be reasoned out of a road she intends to keep.
notes: The closed path is the body and it closes in her own right, from her own tissue: hardening marrow stops the turnover the qi depends on. Never write her refusal of body techniques as modesty, because a modesty can be argued with and this cannot.

Her limit is a subtraction she performs, not a wall she meets. There is no ceiling for her species, no gate has ever refused a longmarrow, and the only reason she is at the ninth is that she refuses to fund a gate out of tissue older than the decision to climb it.
The store renews rather than fills. That is why every institution around her species is an institution of give, and it is why declining is a technique here and a character note everywhere else.

On the Starmetal Scar her lifespan is the shortest anybody's, because that tier runs five to fifty times slower. Two hundred and seventy years is very nearly nothing on this ground and she chose it anyway for the approach.

Write her as someone who will still be there. Anything that treats her as delaying something is writing the wrong character, because from where she stands the ladder is longer than her life and the Scar is the only durable claim available.

art.palette_notes: Road grey, wet stone and the cold white of old bone across everything she owns, with one worn blue at the collar and cuffs of a forty-year-old coat mended so often the thread no longer matches the cloth. No colour on her body and none anywhere else in frame; the only saturated object is the star metal of the staff head. Cold flat daylight as the key, because her species feels no cold and the image should not either, with no warm rim on the face and no interior light in any shot. Slow, wide, low-horizon framings throughout, and every pose must read as a figure that is not going anywhere: nothing blurred, nothing lunging, nothing caught mid-action.
